definitions.short: Ephron , the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine
definitions.full: H6085. Ephron עֶפְרוֺן proper name Εφρων : — 1. masculine Hittite, Abraham's time , according to Gen 23:8 , 10 (twice in verse); 23:13 , 16 , 17 ; 49:29 , עֶפְרֹן 23:6 ; 25:9 ; 49:30 ; 50:13 (all P). 2. location 2Chr 13:19 Kt ( עֶפְיִן Qr), compare עָפְרָה 1a. 3. mont. ׳הַרעֿ , on northern border of Judah Josh 15:9 . עֶפְרַ֫יִן 2Chr 13:19 Qr see עֶפְרוֺן 2 above
